evidence: Middleware (localDiskBridgePlugin.ts:417-424) routes on URL prefix only; grep finds no Origin/Host/token/Content-Type check. vite.config.ts binds 127.0.0.1:5173, no cors/allowedHosts overrides. Live probe on 127.0.0.1:5199 with scratch logs dir (Vite 8.3.5): POST /api/telemetry/session with Origin https://evil.example and Content-Type text/plain returned 200 and the session was started (which truncates the logs). Same POST with Host: evil.example returned 403 from Vite's host validation (in Vite 8 it is installed before plugin configureServer hooks, node.js ~25057-25064). OPTIONS preflight with Origin evil and Request-Method PUT returned 204 with no Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so browsers would block PUT/DELETE. Server stopped.
note: Browser rules, from memory only (no web check): Chrome's Private Network Access preflight idea was replaced by a Local Network Access permission prompt (about Chrome 142, late 2025). That is a user prompt, not a hard block, and does not apply from non-Chrome browsers or if the user clicks allow, so it is a mitigation rather than a refutation. Vite's own cors default only adds headers; it does not reject simple requests.

evidence: compact() uses readFileSync/writeFileSync/renameSync on both whole files (NdjsonSessionTelemetry.ts 297-320), called from recordBatch inside the Vite middleware handler. After compaction activeLogBytes is set to the retained bytes, so if verbatim high-signal entries within the window exceed the cap it recompacts every batch. writeAtomic swaps via .tmp. enforceCompactedStorageCap evicts by tier including tier 3 (warn/error), so SKILL.md:17 '100% Preserved Verbatim' is false at the cap. queryLogs.ts:186-190 prints every record, no limit/tail/summary, and a missing logs dir yields no output and no message. No tests for ENOSPC or torn lines.
note: A torn trailing line is skipped by parseNdjsonLines rather than crashing, which I did not confirm in depth, so 'lossy' on that path is plausible but not proven. 'A log nothing feeds' is true today because browser telemetry is not wired.
